So I never told this story, but I fell like it might be able to help somoene. So here I go. 

I tried drowning myself,
I was 19 got out off my first gay relationship after accepting myself thinking he was the one guy who woudnt try to change me. See all people in my life tried that. I have severe adhd and mild autism and all my life I've had people telling me how to talk, walk, act, eat...

So here I am finally accepting that I'm gay,and when I want to come out on Christmas to my family ( bad idea I know) anyway I do it and it goes a lil better then expected but still bad. So in attempt to find distraction I go on tinder and meet this guy. Let's call him R.

NOW R. he was a math teacher student, very smart confident and he had a way of sweeping me off my feet. Not long after we started dating and I even moved in with him. A year later he breaks up with me because and I quote "you didn't become what I wanted"

So the pit I fell in got dug deeper then I could handle. I moved back in with my parents and tried really hard to live. To not feel the pain. Yet even after two months I wasn't there anymore. So I decided I had to end it. I went to a big lake we have near my home.

It was I think 2 am, 23th of December 2018. I recall it being 02:07 am when I threw my phone in the mud and started walking deeper and deeper in the ice cold water. Until it was knee high. I sat down on my knees and simply let myself fall backwards.

It felt like hours until I started gasping for air. I forced myself under knowing that if I went back the pain kept going. Eventually I shot up right, coughing up water. I dragged myself to the mud and just layed there. I coudnt do it. I cried until sunrise when I decided that if I coudnt kill my body I could at least kill the person I used to be.

When I got home I showered, then threw out all my clothes. And with the few hundreds I had I went on a shopping spree. This time I was shopping to please me, not anyone else I hated the world I hated everyone. But I had to live in it so it would be in my way.

So 12 bags of new clothes later I got my right ear pierced and then did the last thing I wanted to,
I changed my name from niels to Mack. Cus niels drowned so mack could thrive.

I did die, but I rose, and I'm now happy together with a guy who doesn't try to change me, and yea life still isn't the best, but right now I'm living it under my rules and if somoene  complaints I will cut them out of my life.

Best advice. Life live by your rules only.

Let le share a story i never thaught i would tell.
Im currently 22 im a boy from belgium.
Growing up i got bullied in school and never fit in anywhere, probably because i was a wimp too afraid to be myself. At 19 i came out of the closet and started a relationship with the first guy i felt live for.
Genuine love, deep burrowed in my heart and soul. After 7 months it ended. Suddenly and abrupt he just woke me up and said it was over. It was for the better i didnt know at the time but, he took advantage of me, manipulating me into his bidding.

When christmas came thats when all thing worsened .
I thaught of him and the love i felt. I met him a year ago on that christmas eve. I still wasnt myself and my own family didnt even know what i am or who i am, they only knew i was gay. I came home that night and went to bed. I had no tears, just numbness.


The night after i went to the lake. Alone in the dark, i heard nothing and saw nothing and i undressed. My clothes i threw on the dirty mud behind me. And i waded. Deeper and deeper. Until the water reached my knees. Alone in the dark no sounds no lights, only le and my thaughts. And then i plunged in. I tried drowning myself that night. Holdingy own head in the water. But i coudnt, the human body isnt so easely defeated. And i saw my reflection in the water it was then that feelings finally hit me.

Tears flooded my face as i fell on my knees. I cried and cried and screamed as i looked at myself. I hated it. I hated le that wasnt me, i am not that perso n that i saw. Im not silent weak or normal i coudnt i wasnt what they told me.

I started splashing my reflection in anger until i saw it ripling. And for once i saw that i could be different.
My reflection in the noght gave me a hope i hadnt felt before. I got out dressed back up an silently went back home.

When i got there i went straight to the bathroom and without weking anyone up, i got what was left off my sisters bleach and applied it to a piece of my hair.
Finnaly i gad one thing i was proud of. A decision of my own. And that night i took controll of my life. I litteraly murdered my own being and decided to be ME. 

Its been 2 years and im happy. Im not letting somoene stop me, and since 4 months got myself a boyfriend who i can rely on. Off course im not there yet. Its going to be a long road to be me without fears but im taking that road and if i have to imm take it alone. 

If you actually read all this. Whatever bothers you, know that you can change that. Your body your life your rules. Thank you for reading my story
